title: Book Three · Chapter 129: The Shop in Her Notebook
story:
On Monday of the second week, Ronan hears about the large cup.

The woman brought it on Saturday. Mr Sun took its size and returned it to her. Now he has the right depth for her shelf.

On Tuesday, Ronan posts his nineteenth letter to Leo. He tells him about the first week and the folded measuring tape.

He pays for the stamp from his separate spending money. The five yuan from work stays in its envelope.

At three, he meets Anna near the old market. She wants to draw the front of a small fruit shop.

The owner has agreed. He points to a place beside the wall.

“You can see the whole front from there.”

Anna opens her notebook. Ronan stands beside her for a minute, then notices a woman with two baskets behind him.

He moves away from the entrance.

“I am the large cupboard today,” he says.

Anna smiles and starts the roof line.

Ronan watches for a while. The fruit seller has left one shutter half closed. It makes the front of the shop look uneven.

“Should he open that?” Ronan asks.

Anna shakes her head.

“I want to draw it like this.”

She puts the half-closed shutter on the page. Then she adds the baskets beneath it.

Ronan goes to the low wall while she works. He watches people choose fruit and carry their bags past her place.

The owner comes out to look at the drawing.

“More fruit next time,” he says. “I sell more than a roof.”

Anna laughs and shows him the unfinished baskets. He nods and goes back inside.

After a while, she joins Ronan on the wall. There is a pencil mark near her thumb. His own fingers have marks too.

She looks from his hand to hers.

“Both at work.”

“I finished at twelve yesterday.”

“Then you can rest.”

She rests her hand in his and leaves the notebook open across her knees.

Ronan looks at the dark shutter. On the page, he can see why she kept it.

“You can tell which shop it is.”

“That is the idea.”

They sit until the shade moves across one end of the wall. Then Anna closes the notebook. She has school maths to finish before her run with Lin tomorrow.

Ronan walks with her to the corner. He gives the fruit seller a wave, and Anna lifts her notebook in answer to his question about the roof.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

shutter＝窗板、卷合的店面挡板；half-closed＝关了一半的；shade＝阴影、阴凉处；separate＝单独的。

## 理解问题

1. 首周六最大杯子的约定由谁实际接待、怎样完成？Ronan当天另算工资了吗？
2. Anna为什么没有让店主打开挡板？她这次外出主要在做谁自己的事？

## 读句子

**He moves away from the entrance.**

拆开看：He / moves away / from the entrance.

他／挪开／离开入口的位置。
